The Ten-Second Onion

Drop in the onion, press once, done. Cookvane Chop runs a four-blade stainless steel cutter on a 300W motor with three speeds, so you go from whole vegetables to an even dice before the pan is hot. Two 3-liter bowls, one glass and one steel, mean you can prep the salsa and the stir-fry without washing up in between.

Why You Will Love It

  • 300W motor, three speeds — pulse for chunky, hold for smooth
  • Four-blade 304 stainless steel cutter

How To Use

Cut large items into quarters, fill the bowl no more than two-thirds, pulse in short bursts and check between pulses. Blades and bowls rinse clean in seconds.

Keep fingers clear of the blade. Not for grinding bones or ice.
